Name: FloatChestLabel
Author: Nookick
Description:
[size=3][i][b]Introduction [English/Chinese][/b]
[/i][/size]A mod that allows to add float labels on chests. So you can organize/classify your chests in an easier way.

[b]Guide[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Keyboard Shortcut[/b]: Hover your mouse over any chest and press the `L` key
[*][b]In-Menu Button[/b]: Open any chest and click the hammer button on the right side of the menu
[/list]
[b]Basic Settings[/b][i](via Generic Mod Config Menu)[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Enable Labels[/b]: Turn on/off all chest labels globally
[*][b]Max Label Length[/b]: Maximum characters allowed (5-50, default: 20)
[*][b]Label Color&Size[/b]: Font setting
[/list]
[size=3][b]Installation Instructions:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Download and install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] version 4.2.1 or later.[/b]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code] folder.
[/list][/size][list]
[*](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ to make mod configuration easier
[/list][url=https://ibb.co/dsLXFD23][img]https://i.ibb.co/zW7CpZRL/labels.png[/img][/url]
